donor_drive_power.item: Motor controller Basicmicro RoboClaw 2x30A (IMC413): 2 x 30 A cont / 60 A peak, 6-34 V, dual quadrature encoder inputs, closed-loop speed PID, per-channel current limit, voltage clamp output, USB/TTL serial. Replaces Roboteq FDCG3260T (EUR 968).
donor_drive_power.why: EUR 148.44 incl. VAT (fetched; "re-stocking soon" - Pololu 3684 US$134.95 is the second source). STO is no longer needed: safe torque-off is done by two series contactors KM1/KM2 + spring brakes (s.3). Climb needs ~17-20 A/motor (s.4) < 30 A cont; current limit set to 28 A. Cheaper fallback Cytron MDDS30 EUR 82.95 (vanallesenmeer.nl, fetched) has no settable current limit and no encoder loop - not equal.

donor_drive_power.item: Wheel encoders x2: magnetic AB-quadrature hall kit on each wheel/axle (AS5047P ABI board is the alternative)
Battery hatch hasp + padlock (lockable box deleted by lean package R4; pack sits under the top hatch)

Reverse-polarity protection: Anderson SB50 pair + 10 A charge fuse (G4) + Pololu 5388 20 A ideal diode on the unswitched control bus + 1N5408 in the KM coil feed (KM cannot close on a reversed pack) + SMDJ33A TVS on the drive bus
donor_drive_power.why: A 60-80 A ideal diode in the motor path (IDLD-100-TWOG, 80 A, EUR 9.53 ex VAT, hestore.eu) would block MDDS30 regenerative current and pump the bus above 35 V. The 100 A contactor already in series becomes the RPP element: zero extra heat in the motor path; Pololu 5388 (<3 mOhm, 20 A) dissipates ~0.1 W at 6 A.

donor_drive_power.item: DONOR powerchair, rear- or mid-wheel drive, 24 V, 2 brushed gearmotors with spring brakes, solid/foam tyres or fitted with them, casters, frame, 2 x 12 V AGM 35-55 Ah, off-board 24 V charger (moves to the dock). Seat, joystick and controller removed (resale not credited). BUY ONLY AFTER the pull test in s.10 (>= 450 N drawbar at walking pace for 3 min on the seller's driveway, luggage scale + rope)
donor_drive_power.why: Irish listings EUR 380-850 for working chairs (DoneDeal / adverts.ie search excerpts, 11 Nov), eBay IE Jazzy Elite ES "needs battery" EUR 384. A chair rated for a 136 kg user on 6-9 deg moves 246 kg up 10.5-15.8 %: drawbar demand of the tug + bin at 12 % is 386-451 N, i.e. inside that envelope only for chairs rated >= 8 deg (s.4).

donor_drive_power.item: Traction battery = the donor AGM pair (24 V 35-55 Ah, 21-30 kg, also the ballast). Replace with 2 x 12 V 35 Ah AGM (~EUR 140) if the capacity test shows < 80 %. LiFePO4 pack, its BMS and the pack heater are not needed (AGM charges below 0 C at reduced current)
